ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, everyday work and team collaboration across all your places. Find any Antz task with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Touch any card to open its guide with all the functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: The functions of each module and the real screens can be found in this guide. Continue from where you stopped, or ask us, and we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day with Antz looks like
ui.day.1: Log in to your work environment
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that correspond to your organization and switch on permissions for each module separately, so that everyone sees what is needed for his work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers work on the spot, for example notes, treatment, moving and egg records. The web app covers office work, for example the hospital system, nursery (hatchery) setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on the phone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we determine who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles used by your organization, for example 'Zoologist', and switch on permissions for each module separately.
ui.faq.q4: We have several places. Does it work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz stores the data of all places and departments in one place. Accommodation is arranged by place, section and enclosure, and moving between places happens with approval and security sign-out [?].
ui.faq.a5: Start with the guide 'Starting work', then open the modules that your role uses. If anything is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The necropsy module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, organ findings and medical conclusions. It supports precise analysis of the cause of death, standardizes reporting, ensures timely handling of the corpse and complies with legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by place, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the stages: incoming, waiting, drafts and completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The deworming module supports systematic recording and monitoring of anti-parasite treatment, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation and clear tracking of each deworming for each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Deworming is arranged in the categories 'Upcoming', 'Waiting', 'Skipped' and 'Completed' for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course or directly record an administered medication with set dates and information.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and, optionally, a repeat check.
m.housing.title: Accommodation
m.housing.intro: The accommodation module arranges animal dwellings across all your places, sections and enclosures, so that each animal's location is known and each change is tracked. Access at each level is based on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Administration of places
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit places with role-based permissions for secure, structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Administration of sections
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections in the zoo with permission-based control for secure administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Administration of enclosures
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each of them for efficient oversight of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The fetal death module records and manages cases of fetal death in enclosures, capturing the cause, time and information on the related animals. It supports veterinary care, reproductive health monitoring, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases, cause, time, origin, animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by place, date, stillborn fetus or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing records of the dead
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full information, days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, place, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs – from laying to the moment of hatching or handing over to the nursery (hatchery) –, ensuring accurate records, real-time updates and full traceability for better coordination and accountability of nest, nursery and incubation teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg information panel
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Current count: in nests, handed to the nursery, marked for destruction.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes, attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full timeline of the egg's path (Egg Journey Timeline).
m.administer-medicine.title: Administering medications
m.administer-medicine.intro: The administration module supplements medical records, turning prescriptions into practical treatment workflows and making it possible to provide care in real time to individual animals or groups, both on the spot and in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the chosen date without filling in a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records and narrow the list by date, unit, species, controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatment by date in four tabs: waiting, administered, skipped, discontinued.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the whole animal vaccination cycle – from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, waiting, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of doses and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are arranged in the categories 'Upcoming', 'Waiting', 'Skipped' and 'Completed' for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record an administered vaccine with set dates and medication information.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and, optionally, a repeat check.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Provides quick, accurate and traceable issuing of medical products directly to authorized doctors, guaranteeing timely execution and automatic stock updating from prescription to shelf, with an overview at batch level and tracking of expiry dates throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Information panel
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insights into stock problems, shipments, procurements, requests, consumption, expiry dates and most-demanded products, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Basic data (stands and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Arrange storage by the number of stands/shelves for quick access and updates, with customizable data (packaging, units of measurement, salts, drivers, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Management of stock write-off reports
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batches with value and expiry date; mark low/depleted stock; monitor approaching expiry dates; manage reserved stock (escrow) with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiry dates, record procurements/dispatches, maintain a unified ledger, manage substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Issuing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and issue medications or receive them directly at the pharmacy, and everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medication shipments and fulfil them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock correction and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, damaged, expired); keep the audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download consumption, returns, procurement and issuing reports for finance and request planning.
m.getting-started.title: Starting work
m.getting-started.intro: The guide 'Starting work' introduces the purpose of the app and shows new users step by step how to set up a profile, explore the main functions and navigate the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and work environments
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access the work environment intended for you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home stream for news, quick navigation shortcuts and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Waiting necropsy / administration / placement
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals waiting for necropsy, administrative documentation and further placement or disposal before the final closing of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Basic settings and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure the basic data and explore modules such as medical records, accommodation, eggs, feed and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update the profile and adjust language settings.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for safe work.
